evidence.quote: From `+5V`, a second diode D2 (PMEG3030EP, annotated "3A 360mV" in the schematic — a low-forward-voltage-drop Schottky) feeds a dedicated servo power rail backed by four 100 µF capacitors (C1–C4) before reaching J3/J8 pin 2.
D2 PMEG3030EP cathode node connects to J3 pin 1 and J8 pin 1; J3 pin 2 and J8 pin 2 connect to GND (page 1, right-hand servo-header section).

anomalies.impact: Servos connected according to the documented pinout would receive ground on the intended power pin and supply on the intended ground pin, preventing correct operation and likely damaging the servo or the board.
